attchmntText: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited filed the transcript for its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 17, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of INR407.16 crores, up 23% year-on-year. EBITDA grew 64% to INR30.70 crores with a margin of 7.5%. Profit after tax increased 72% to INR18.19 crores. The debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.48 from 1.2x in FY26. Capacity utilization reached 65.5% in H1 FY27. The company raised INR99.89 crores via IPO and utilized INR71 crores for debt repayment. Cash position stands at INR38.47 crores as of September 30, 2026. Net working capital days were 64. Management targets capacity utilization of 75% to 80% in H2 FY27. New product lines including solar structures and nuts and bolts are being introduced.

attchmntText: NRB Industrial Bearings Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 (SEBI) LODR, 2015.
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: NRB Industrial Bearings Limited voluntarily disclosed an interim order from the Hon’ble Bombay High Court dated 04 November 2026. The order restrains the Company from using the marks NRB Industrial, NRB Industrial Bearings, and NRB INDL on bearings for mobile vehicles, including automotive and farm equipment. The Company may continue using these marks for industrial applications and may use other marks for mobile vehicle bearings. The Court rejected requests for a Court Receiver and for cancellation of the Company’s Class 12 trademark registration. The Company has halted dispatch of affected stock and preserved existing inventory as directed. The Company assessed the financial impact as below the materiality threshold under SEBI LODR Regulations. No monetary claims were made in the proceedings. The Company is evaluating legal remedies, including an appeal, and will provide updates on further developments.

attchmntText: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 20, 2026, issued by Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, subsidiary of the Company, titled "Ampere achieves 6% E2W market share, consolidating its Top 5 position".
voiceSummary: Greaves Cotton Limited filed a press release regarding its subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility Limited. The release states that the Ampere brand achieved a 6% market share in India’s electric two-wheeler sector. Data for November 1 to 18, 2026, shows 7,956 E2W registrations. This represents a 70% volume increase over the same period in October. The overall EV two-wheeler market grew by 20% during this time. Ampere’s market share rose from 4.3% in October to 6.0% in November. The company consolidated its position in the top five. Registrations for the current financial year reached 72,553 by November 18. This exceeds the total of 61,842 registrations recorded in the previous fiscal year. The announcement notes a presence in approximately 900 RTO markets.

Designated Person S Rajpal Singh, Assistant Manager, sold 37 equity shares for Rs. 15,693.95 on November 11, 2026, during the closed trading window. The company issued a written warning to him.
